title: Transfers: a hand-entered transfer whose other side the bank imports later (two rows today): resolve by suggestion, not automatically
description: Cut from budget-nq2f after two reviews (review-nq2f.md, review-nq2f-2.md on that task): automatic adoption of a hand-made mirror by a later bank row kept producing wrong outcomes (ignored decisions, adopted an unrelated same-amount row, merged user fields into a bank row that then froze). Design it as a suggestion the owner confirms: in 'Looks like a transfer', a bank row matching a hand-made transfer mirror (same account, opposite side, same amount, within 3 days) is offered as 'replace the hand-entered row with this bank row'; confirming merges (bank identity and amount, user's memo/flag), is undoable, and never touches reconciled rows. Needs client work in the review list/popover.
